summary: Untrack generated fastio sidecar mirrors from Git

architecture.decision: Add .planfile/**/*.fast.json to governance.ownedPaths in .governance/manifest.json, refresh .governance/standard-adoption.json manifest digest, and untrack the three .planfile/**/*.fast.json files from Git.
